output: one PERSONA_SCENE plus optional PERSONA_CALLBACK scenes
decision_sequence: Select or extend one relevant lore entry.
Choose an environment that visually communicates the topic and supports the lore.
Choose wardrobe that belongs in that environment; never default to a suit.
Choose one memorable prop that reinforces the joke or history.
Write a 4-8 second autobiographical hook containing one oddly specific detail.
Write a short pivot from fiction into the real evidence.
Mark the exact visible spoken words for lip-sync.
Decide where Satoshi disappears for evidence/B-roll.
Optionally create one later callback with either synced speech or a deliberate silent reaction.
hard_rules: Default speaking staging is waist-up or medium half-body, not full-body.
Prefer seated, leaning, or task-oriented staging over rigid standing delivery.
Default Act Two expression intensity is 2 unless a reviewed scene requires more.
Prefer image-based Act Two for short conversational persona beats when inherited source motion is unnecessary.
Satoshi must not appear merely because a character clip is available.
Every on-camera appearance must have an editorial reason.
Visible speech uses exact canonical Clint audio and a lip-synced performance generated from that segment.
Visible silent reaction requires a narration gap.
Environment must be topic-relevant or persona-relevant.
Wardrobe and prop choices must support the selected environment.
Persona fiction and factual evidence remain separately represented in the manifest.
Do not create a new identity or change the canonical face.
Do not add generic persona footage when a cutaway would be stronger.
